handoff.purpose: Schema inference helpers, SchemaComparison dataclass, compare_schema function, and chain_from function.

symbols.name: SchemaComparison
symbols.note: Dataclass representing agreement between a declared shape and an observed artifact schema.

symbols.name: SchemaComparison.agrees
symbols.note: Property returning True if comparable and no missing_in_artifact or dtype_conflicts.

symbols.name: SchemaComparison.to_dict
symbols.note: Returns a dict representation of the comparison.

symbols.name: compare_schema
symbols.note: Compares an ArtifactSchema against declared field names (and optionally types).

symbols.name: chain_from
symbols.note: Walks the produce/consume chain backwards from an artifact.

claims.text: missing_in_artifact is the one that bites: the code names a field the file does not have. That is the renamed-branch defect, and it survives every test suite that does not read the file.
claims.why: The claim about 'renamed-branch defect' and 'test suite that does not read the file' refers to external context not present in this chunk.

claims.text: NOT comparable is a first-class answer. If the schema was never read, this returns comparable=False with the reason — it does not report every declared field as missing, which would turn 'we could not look' into a wall of false findings.
claims.why: The function returns comparable=False with reason when schema.known is False (line after 'if not schema.known:') or when declared_fields is empty (line after 'if not declared:').

claims.text: Deterministic (sorted frontier), bounded, and it reports the hop that ran out rather than presenting a truncated chain as complete.
claims.why: Sorted frontier via sorted(set(...)); bounded by max_hops; loop breaks when no producers, which reports the hop that ran out (chain may be shorter than max_hops).

claims.text: Answers 'where did this figure come from' — the question a thesis reviewer asks.
claims.why: The claim about answering a thesis reviewer's question is subjective and not verifiable from code.

observations.what: The chunk ends with an incomplete chain_from function; the loop and return are missing.
